intro: Saturday brings provincial voting, stronger Canadian retail sales and practical changes to AI serving software. November planning includes opera, a software gathering at Science World and two seasonal dining experiences.

stories.title: B.C. votes today, with polls closing at eight
stories.summary: Voting stations open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. today as British Columbians choose their provincial government. Bring identification proving your identity and residential address; the Where to Vote card is helpful but is not required.

stories.title: Microsoft traces agent-driven attacks through cloud applications
stories.summary: Microsoft’s October 21 investigation links Storm-0940 to ARTEX-assisted attacks and stolen ConnectWise application credentials used against more than 2,250 tenants. Administrators should review application permissions, credential additions and unusual app-only activity; successful authentication alone does not establish data theft.

stories.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash gains immediate serving support
stories.summary: SGLang and Miles announced launch-day support for MiniMax M3.1 Flash on October 22. The multimodal model accepts text, images and video over a million-token context, giving deployment teams a published serving route alongside its downloadable weights.

stories.title: SGLang opens a production PyTorch serving route to TPUs
stories.summary: RadixArk, Google and Meta released SGLang-TorchTPU on October 20, bringing the serving engine’s PyTorch codebase to Google Cloud TPUs. The collaborators say it already runs in production at Meta, offering another hardware option for inference workloads.

stories.title: Shared GPU memory tackles stranded cache capacity
stories.summary: SGLang’s October 22 engineering report describes a shared buffer for attention caches and recurrent states, replacing fixed allocations that can leave memory unused. Its cache-pressure experiment retained 1.9 times as many prefixes; results depend on the tested workload.

stories.title: August retail growth extends across every subsector
stories.summary: Statistics Canada reported Friday that August retail sales rose 1.2% to $74.6 billion, with increases in all nine subsectors. Sales volumes also increased 1.2%, while core sales excluding vehicles and fuel advanced 1.1%, indicating growth beyond price changes.

events.title: Tosca returns Thursday with English projected titles
events.description: Joyce El-Khoury takes the title role in Vancouver Opera’s new co-production with Pacific Opera Victoria, conducted by Jacques Lacombe. Puccini’s drama is sung in Italian with English projected titles; allow approximately two hours and 20 minutes, including intermission.

meetups.title: BIOS SPHERE brings software builders into one room
meetups.description: The afternoon conference features talks on coding agents, agent workflows and software design. Kent C. Dodds leads a separate morning workshop. Choose conference or combined admission on Luma; the refund deadline has passed, although tickets remain transferable.

meetups.title: WordCamp Canada covers development, accessibility and performance
meetups.description: The two-day WordPress gathering offers sessions and workshops spanning development, design, accessibility and content strategy. Regular admission is $100 and includes lunches and breaks. November 4 Contributor Day requires separate registration alongside an eligible conference ticket.

dining.title: Radicchio carries an autumn tasting menu
dining.description: Burdock’s current Frost Moon menu moves through chicories with shrimp, pine mushrooms, dry-aged duck and sea-urchin gelato. The tasting menu is $175, with wine and zero-proof pairings available separately. The restaurant’s seasonal menu page links reservations.

dining.title: Haunted Cellar tea enters its final stretch
dining.description: Notch8’s seasonal afternoon tea continues through November 1, with pastries, savoury bites and autumn confections in a gothic tea salon. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeaway versions, making this a dated alternative to its forthcoming winter service.
